# MCQsAI

> AI-powered exam preparation platform for Pakistani students — MDCAT, ECAT, CSS, PPSC, FPSC, NTS, and board exams (Matric, FSc) with 6000+ MCQs, AI tutor, and Urdu/Sindhi language support.

MCQsAI helps Pakistani students prepare for competitive and board exams with adaptive AI-generated tests, past papers, syllabus-aligned MCQs, and a personal AI study coach. Content covers all major Pakistani education boards (BISE, FBISE) and entrance/competitive exams.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of MCQsAI features and exam prep tools.
- [Boards](/boards): Pakistani education boards (BISE, FBISE) with class, subject, and topic-level MCQs.
- [Exams](/exams): Competitive exam landing pages — MDCAT, ECAT, CSS, PPSC, NTS, FPSC.
- [AI Study Coach](/features/ai-coach): Free AI-powered study coach — conversational guidance, weak-area detection, personalized recommendations, and spaced-repetition revisions for Pakistan exams.
- [Subjects](/subjects): Subject-wise MCQ practice across medical, engineering, sciences, and social sciences.
- [Past Papers](/past-papers): Past paper MCQs for board and competitive exams.
- [Mock Tests](/mock-tests): Full-length timed mock tests.
- [Custom Quizzes](/custom-quizzes): Build your own quiz by topic and difficulty.
- [Ask Document](/ask-document): Upload a PDF and ask questions or generate MCQs.
- [Tools](/tools): Free student tools — GPA, percentage, CGPA, attendance, unit converters, calculators.
- [Jobs](/jobs): Pakistan government and private job listings with test prep.
- [Scholarships](/scholarships): Scholarship opportunities for Pakistani students.
- [Blog](/blog): Study guides, exam tips, and education news.
- [About](/about): About MCQsAI.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch.
- [FAQ](/faq): Frequently asked questions.
